_meta.source: Design document, sections 9.1 and 15 (Sealed Cave rows)
notes: kind 'material' is something found in the world; 'resource' is fuel for skills; 'harmful' is what Isolation converts to magicules; 'consumable' is used from the Stomach.
ep is the magicules absorbed when one is devoured. analysis_time is the unlinked analysis time in seconds.
The hipokute herb's analysis time mirrors canon in miniature: about fifty units unlinked, about one once Analysis is linked to Parallel Processing.
model describes the placeholder shape of a harvestable node in the world.
